title: I Don’t Write Ruby. A Fix I Sent Is Now in Forem.
why_read: A personal story about making a first open-source contribution to Forem using AI coding assistance, more about personal journey than technical depth.
analysis: This post recounts the author's long personal journey from passively reading dev.to to eventually contributing a code fix to Forem, the Ruby-based platform behind dev.to, despite not knowing Ruby themselves. The technical content is thin, mainly noting that an AI coding assistant wrote the actual fix over a 12-week process. It's primarily a motivational and community-oriented story about persistence and introversion rather than a deep dive into the code or problem solved.
